From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Extension opportunity + usage deep dive for Q4 commit

Hi Susan —

Thanks again for the time last week. I pulled together a short usage snapshot and an initial proposal that I think maps to Nimbus's product ramp and cost targets. Highlights below, full CSV + heatmap attached (nim-usage-q3-q4.csv, latency-heatmap.png):

- Usage trend: active token spend up 48% QoQ, peak sequences concentrated in short-chat bursts (avg response length ~120 tokens).
- Cost/ROI: current unit cost with your hosted plan is ~$0.0009/token; with a modest 25% committed uplift, we can reduce blended cost to ~$0.00068/token at your current latency profile.
- Reliability: 99.6% request success rate last 30 days; a handful of spikes tied to concurrent large-batch exports (see heatmap).

What I’d like to propose as next steps:
1) Quick sync with Procurement to confirm timing and T&Cs (60–90 day extension vs. annual renewal).
2) Draft a proposed commitment sheet for a 25% token increase with phased ramp (Q4 spike protection + Q1 steady state).
3) If helpful, I can pull a short SLA uplift option from our Dedicated offering for mission-critical flows.

If you’re open, I’ll loop in our finance and product leads to draft numbers.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Procurement — looping you in to check timing constraints for a short extension (we prefer 60 days to give us runway).

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Nimbus ask — extension + capped pilot ramp

Team —

Nimbus (Susan Park) is asking for a 60-day extension and a 25% uplift to committed tokens. They specifically want a phased ramp with a hard cap during the mid-December pilot week. Key numbers from my analysis (attached proposed-commit-sheet.xlsx):

- Current 30-day token run-rate: ~2.3B tokens (chat + embeddings).
- Proposed commit: +25% = 2.875B tokens/month (discount schedule attached).
- Target blended price: ~$0.00068/token (assumes caching & burst throttles).

Options to present:
A) 60-day bridge extension to lock current pricing, include pilot-week hard cap (we absorb overage up to 10% at discounted rate).
B) 12-month extension with phased ramp and deeper unit pricing (needs legal signoff on early termination clause).
C) Pilot-only SLA uplift (Dedicated-lite) for high-critical flows during pilot week — 1-week trial of priority routing.

Need:
- Dylan: confirm whether we can commit to absorbing 10% overage during pilot (finance tolerance).
- Marcus: can product support a hard cap/rate-limit rule per customer for the pilot?
- Monica: if Procurement signs off, can you draft a 60-day amendment template we can send?

I’ll pick up the HubSpot record and create a MAS (mutual action plan) if we get Procurement OK.

Thanks —
Vanessa

Attachments: proposed-commit-sheet.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Susan Park <susan@nimhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Extension opportunity + usage deep dive for Q4 commit

Vanessa —

Appreciate the options. Procurement is aligned with a 60-day bridge extension if we can get a written commitment around the pilot-week hard cap and a clear overage protection. Our ask:

- 60-day extension effective 12/01/2026 to 01/30/2027.
- Hard cap for pilot week (Dec 14–20): 3.5B tokens max; any overage beyond that is billed at +0.20x the committed rate (not list rate).
- We want a clearly documented rollback plan if latency degrades beyond 200ms p50 for critical endpoints.

If you can send a short amendment and the MAS, Procurement can fast-track sign-off.

Susan —

Great news: Procurement has confirmed they can review a 60-day amendment and we’ve got tentative internal approval to absorb limited pilot overage as a concession to secure the extension. Next steps below and I’ve attached the MOPA draft (mopa-draft.pdf) for your review.

Mutual action plan (M.A.P.):

- 12/14–12/20/2026: Pilot week cap active (3.5B tokens); Redwood absorbs first 10% overage, further overage billed at +0.20x committed rate.
- 12/21/2026: Post-pilot health check call — p50/p95 latency, error-rate, token consumption review.
- 01/15/2027: Decision checkpoint for conversion to 12-month phased commit.

Attached: mopa-draft.pdf (draft amendment + MAP). I’ll open the HubSpot MAS and attach the signed amendment once we have Proc signatures: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765

If this looks good, I’ll route for DocuSign and loop Dylan for the finance confirmation on the exact absorption threshold.

Thanks for moving quickly on this — appreciate the partnership.
